intro.text: A lighteyed soldier on the Shattered Plains, among those guarding the highprinces in case of an attack by the Assassin in White.
A Shardbearer from Highprince Aladar's warcamp and one of the more skilled duelists on the Shattered Plains.

items.text: Abrobadar was at the meeting of the highprinces when Shallan arrived on the Plains, standing guard against the Assassin in White with General Khal, Jakamav, Resi and Relis.

Abrobadar was one of four Shardbearers facing Adolin in a duel. He went after Renarin and was distracted for a time by Pattern, then rejoined the main fight once Kaladin began to turn it, and was beaten by Adolin.
His orange Shardplate was given by Adolin to Moash, at Kaladin's request.
